description: Indicative SPML valuation for a Singapore unit. Requires postal code and unit number in FF-SS format (e.g. "04-02"). propertyType ("Condo" or "HDB") and areaSqft are optional — when propertyType is omitted, both types are probed and the one that values the unit is used (`propertyTypeUsed` in the result tells you which). A `valued: false` result means SPML could not value the unit — that is a valid answer, not an error.

areaSqft.description: Optional built-in/strata area in sqft; can rescue a "$0" valuation.

postalCode.description: Postal code of the building the unit is in, e.g. "248973".

propertyType.description: Whether the unit is a private condominium or an HDB flat. Omit to auto-detect: both are probed and the one that values the unit is used (`propertyTypeUsed` reports which).

unitNumber.description: Floor and stack of the unit, e.g. "04-02" for floor 4, stack 02.

name: get_property_valuation

capitalGain.description: Estimated capital gain since last transaction (SGD), or null.

pricePerSqft.description: Indicative price per square foot (SGD), or null.

pricePerSqm.description: Indicative price per square metre (SGD), or null.

propertyTypeUsed.description: The property type that produced the valuation, or null if unvalued.

raw.description: Raw SPML response strings, for display/debugging.

requestedPropertyType.description: The property type the caller requested, or null if auto-detection was used.

valuation.description: Indicative market value in SGD, or null if unvalued.

valued.description: True if SPML returned a valuation; false means the unit could not be valued.

title: Get indicative property valuation
